[head=3][color=#ff0000]WARNING: You must be 18 or older to play. Users under 18 will be banned immediately.[/head][/color]
[color=#99ff99]Triad is an english speaking 18+ medium roleplay server[/color]
[color=#a4885c][head=3]Implementation and interpretation of the rules is up to the sole discretion of the Admins.[/head][/color]
• Admins will instead be held accountable through use of the Admin code of conduct.
